Chapter 6532: Summoning Horn

Chapter 6532: Summoning Horn

“Oo-” A summoning horn sounded throughout Heaven World.

“What is this?” People became startled by the ancient and dignified horn.

They imagined a supreme existence sitting on a throne, ready to give out commands.

“Life-and-death Heaven’s summoning horn!” Many mighty cultivators became emotional.

“For what? Declaring war?” Those who knew of it became startled.

This summoning horn was rarely used outside of special occasions. The last time was during Nightwatch where the strongest cultivators including Desolate Ancestor came.

Only Supreme Heaven could stop them but Zhan Sansheng was no longer around.

“Prepare the defenses.” The elusive Weizhen gave the order without stepping out.

“Boom!” Pillars of light initiated a grand formation spanning across Heaven World.

“Is Supreme Heaven starting the fight?” Everyone became afraid since they were helpless before two behemoths.

“No, it is still a defensive stance.” Someone answered since the formation didn’t provoke Life-and-death Heaven.

Supreme Heaven remained cautious despite the other side summoning their troops.

“Rumble!” A figure with divine rings appeared on a peak flying toward Life-and-death Heaven.

“Summit Primal Ancestor!” Someone shouted.

“Splash!” A tsunami started in a particular ocean due to the emergence of a great being.

He was a golden skeleton with a blinding radiance and floating divine rings. He looked regal and dignified instead of frightening.

“Greatbones God!” Those nearby shouted.

With just one step, he entered Life-and-death Heaven to show his support.

At another location was a void. Auspicious clouds suddenly took over and flew toward Heaven World. Within was a supreme beauty capable of making men drop to their knees.

The wave of her hand could pull countless existences into her sleeve. Her murderous potential stood in stark contrast to her beauty.

“Skynet Demoness.” Those who had seen her in action were frightened.

She also entered Life-and-death Heaven in the blink of an eye.

Just that like, numerous powerful cultivators emerged publicly once more, gathering at the greatest speed.

Many in Heaven World were born after Nightwatch and had never seen something so magnificent before. Seeing one of these cultivators was a rare honor, let alone all of them.

“Can’t ask for more authority.” A spectator said regarding the lord’s influence.

“Is it to protect her?” Many speculated due to the message stating her near ascension.

“Supreme Heaven will have to act.” Some said.

However, Supreme Heaven didn’t gather their troops and looked to be on the offensive.

“I don’t think they have the firepower to attack. Zhan Sansheng is awaiting rebirth.” Someone said.

“They’re worrying about her ascension, or maybe her camp will attack first to rid themselves of potential complications.” A big shot said.

Supreme Heaven was at its weakest without Zhan Sansheng. Perhaps it was the right time for Life-and-death Heaven to make a move. Why would they wait until his return?
